#docs
Archived sets are left out unless `include_archived=true`.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `include_archived` | `boolean` | no | Set to `true` to also list archived rows. |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Opt-in paging. Without `limit` or `starting_after` every matching row is returned as `{ object, data }`; `q`, `sort_by` and `field[op]` filters apply either way. With either, the response is one page with `has_more`, `next_cursor` and `total` (`limit` defaults to 50). |
| `starting_after` | `string` | no | Opaque cursor from a previous next_cursor |
| `offset` | `string` | no | The previous page's next_offset — the same token as next_cursor under a second name. Pass one of offset or starting_after, not two different values. |
| `q` | `string` | no | Matches id or name |
| `sort_by[asc]` | `string` | no | Sort ascending by this field. |
| `sort_by[desc]` | `string` | no | Sort descending by this field. |
| `id` | `object` | no | Filter on `id`. Send as `id[<operator>]=<value>`. |
| `name` | `object` | no | Filter on `name`. Send as `name[<operator>]=<value>`. |
| `coupon` | `object` | no | Filter by the coupon's id (a slug id, e.g. `welcome-10`). |
| `created_at` | `object` | no | Filter on `created_at`. Send as `created_at[<operator>]=<value>`. |
| `archived_at` | `object` | no | Filter on `archived_at`. Send as `archived_at[<operator>]=<value>`. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `data.id` | `string` | The coupon set's id (`launch-codes`). |
| `data.name` | `string` | The coupon set's name. |
| `data.coupon` | `string` | The id of the coupon the codes in this set redeem (a slug id, e.g. `welcome-10`). |
| `data.total_count` | `integer` | Number of codes in the set. |
| `data.redeemed_count` | `integer` | Number of codes already redeemed. |
| `data.archived_count` | `integer` | Codes withdrawn via archive — spent, but not by a customer. |
| `data.unredeemed_count` | `integer` | Still redeemable. Not total_count − redeemed_count: archived codes are neither. |
| `data.created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the coupon set was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `data.archived_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the set was archived (ISO-8601 UTC), or null. |
| `data.metadata` | `object` | Key-value pairs you attach to the coupon set. |
